# appsignal_log_trigger (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appsignal_app" "example" {
  name        = "my-example-app"
  environment = "production"
}

resource "appsignal_log_source" "example" {
  app_id = appsignal_app.example.id

  name = "my-example-log-source"
  fmt  = "AUTODETECT"
  type = "application"
}

resource "appsignal_log_trigger" "example" {
  app_id = appsignal_app.example.id

  source_ids = [appsignal_log_source.example.id]

  name  = "my-trigger"
  query = "hostname=web"

  severities = ["FATAL"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) The ID of the app to which the log trigger belongs.
- `name` (String) The name of the log trigger.
- `query` (String) The query string that will execute the log trigger.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the log trigger. Omit the attribute to clear it.
- `notification_options` (String) Notification option. One of: `ALWAYS`, `NEVER`, `FIRST_IN_DEPLOY`, `FIRST_AFTER_CLOSE`, `NTH_IN_HOUR`, `NTH_IN_DAY`.
- `notification_trigger_value` (Number) Notification threshold.
- `notifier_ids` (Set of String) The IDs of the notifiers this trigger notifies.
- `severities` (Set of String) The severities the log trigger matches. Each one of: `TRACE`, `DEBUG`, `INFO`, `NOTICE`, `WARN`, `ERROR`, `CRITICAL`, `ALERT`, `FATAL`, `UNKNOWN`.
- `source_ids` (Set of String) The IDs of the log sources for which this trigger is active.

### Read-Only

- `action_type` (String) The action the log trigger performs. Assigned by AppSignal, one of: `TRIGGER`, `FILTER`, `METRICS`.
- `id` (String) The ID of the log trigger.
- `notifiers` (Attributes Set) The notifiers this trigger notifies, with their names resolved by AppSignal. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notifiers))
- `order` (Number) The order of the log trigger.

<a id="nestedatt--notifiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notifiers`

Read-Only:

- `icon` (String) The icon of the notifier.
- `id` (String) The ID of the notifier.
- `name` (String) The name of the notifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import appsignal_log_trigger.example "<app_id>,<log_trigger_id>"
```
